changes: Analog radial joystick replaces the direction-pad buttons.
Joystick has proportional movement, radial dead zone, clamped thumb travel and independent pointer ownership.
Full-viewport game camera with floating lower-corner joystick and A/B actions; no reserved side panels.
Logical viewport width fits available aspect ratio at fixed 360 height, clamped by existing renderer to 320..900.
Safe-area-aware HUD and utility targets, adjustable touch size and left/right swap.
Pause, blur, cancellation, lost capture, rotation and disposal clear input and recenter thumb.
Shared fullscreen preference and orientation guard retained; no shared shell or Retro Football code changed.
limitations: Desktop Chromium/SwiftShader with emulated touch; physical Android/iOS checks remain unperformed.
Browser/OS controls fullscreen availability; unsupported fullscreen retains a fitted viewport.
Very wide ratios beyond 900/360 use contain fitting to preserve proportions.
Existing source-fidelity limitations from character-v7 remain.
